# Power and sample size calculation for test of R-squared = 0
# Linear regression with intercept and 3 predictors
# H0: ρ² = 0, H1: ρ² ≠ 0 (two-sided test)

library(pwr)

# Parameters
rho <- 0.30  # anticipated multiple correlation
p <- 3       # number of predictors
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

# Calculate effect size f² from R² = rho²
R_squared <- rho^2
f_squared <- R_squared / (1 - R_squared)

cat("=== Linear Regression Power Analysis ===\n")
cat("Anticipated multiple correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("Anticipated R-squared (ρ²):", R_squared, "\n")
cat("Number of predictors:", p, "\n")
cat("Effect size f²:", f_squared, "\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Use pwr.f2.test to find sample size
# f2 = effect size
# u = numerator df (number of predictors)
# v = denominator df (N - p - 1)
# sig.level = alpha
# power = target power

# The pwr package's pwr.f2.test parameterizes with:
# N = total sample size
# u = numerator df
# v = denominator df

# We need to solve for N such that power = 0.90
# Let's use a search approach

result <- pwr.f2.test(u = p, f2 = f_squared, sig.level = alpha, power = target_power)

cat("pwr.f2.test result:\n")
cat("u (numerator df):", result$u, "\n")
cat("v (denominator df):", result$v, "\n")
cat("f² (effect size):", result$f2, "\n")
cat("Power:", result$power, "\n")
cat("Significance level:", result$sig.level, "\n\n")

# The pwr package returns v as denominator df
# v = N - p - 1, so N = v + p + 1
N_continuous <- result$v + p + 1
cat("Continuous sample size N =", N_continuous, "\n")

# Round up to nearest integer
N_integer <- ceiling(N_continuous)
cat("Minimum integer sample size N =", N_integer, "\n\n")

# Verify power at the minimum integer sample size
v_integer <- N_integer - p - 1
critical_f <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = p, df2 = v_integer)
noncentrality <- f_squared * N_integer / (1 - f_squared) * p / (N_integer - p - 1)

# More precisely: noncentrality parameter λ = f² * (N - p - 1)
lambda <- f_squared * v_integer

power_at_N <- 1 - pf(critical_f, df1 = p, df2 = v_integer, ncp = lambda)

cat("=== Verification at N =", N_integer, "===\n")
cat("Numerator df (u):", p, "\n")
cat("Denominator df (v):", v_integer, "\n")
cat("Critical F-value (α = 0.05):", critical_f, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ:", lambda, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", power_at_N, "\n\n")

# Also check the preceding integer sample size
N_check <- N_integer - 1
v_check <- N_check - p - 1
lambda_check <- f_squared * v_check
critical_f_check <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = p, df2 = v_check)
power_check <- 1 - pf(critical_f_check, df1 = p, df2 = v_check, ncp = lambda_check)

cat("Critical F-value (α = 0.05):", critical_f_check, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ:", lambda_check, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", power_check, "\n\n")

# Final answer

cat("Minimum integer total sample size for 90% power:", N_integer, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at N =", N_integer, ":", power_at_N, "\n")

  metric = c("sample_size", "achieved_power_at_minimum_n", "achieved_power_at_preceding_n", 
             "preceding_sample_size", "effect_size_f_squared", "anticipated_r_squared",

)
